name: Gefitinib
mechanism: Reversible ATP-competitive inhibitor of the EGFR tyrosine kinase, with preferential activity against exon 19 deletion and L858R mutants.
monitoring: Evaluation of new respiratory symptoms for ILD
interactions: Absorption is reduced by drugs that raise gastric pH (proton pump inhibitors, H2 antagonists). CYP3A4 inducers reduce and inhibitors increase exposure. Monitor INR with warfarin.
resistance: Acquired T790M gatekeeper mutation is the dominant mechanism; also MET amplification, HER2 amplification and histological transformation.
